description: This file contains C source code implementing network interface queries and IP address change handling for a CWMP plugin, including functions for updating local IP addresses, handling IPv4 and IPv6 address changes, and managing network queries.

methods.name: getLocalIP
methods.description: Determines the local IP address based on the current WAN IP mode and stored IPv4/IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: updateLocalIP
methods.description: Updates the connection request host with the current local IP address.

methods.name: ipv6_timer_cb
methods.description: Callback function for IPv6 timer to update local IP.

methods.name: ipv6address_changed_cb
methods.description: Handles changes to the IPv6 address, updating internal state and possibly triggering IP update.

methods.name: ipv4address_changed_cb
methods.description: Handles changes to the IPv4 address, updating internal state and possibly triggering IP update.

methods.name: _writeInterface
methods.description: Handles interface parameter change, reinitializing network queries for the specified interface.

methods.name: _writePreferredIPVersion
methods.description: Sets the preferred IP version mode based on input parameter.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_close_queries
methods.description: Closes active network queries and cleans up related resources.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_open_queries
methods.description: Opens network queries for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses on a specified interface.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_netmodel_find_ip
methods.description: Initiates queries to find the WAN interface IP addresses.
